mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_login_log (user_id, login_ip, device, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{loginIp}, #{device}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, login_time AS loginTime, login_ip AS loginIp, device, status FROM user_login_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY login_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
